def check_costas(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    vectors = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            dr = arr[j] - arr[i]
            dc = j - i
            if (dr, dc) in vectors:
                return False
            vectors.add((dr, dc))
    return True
